summary: Tested 3 requested features: 1) Chat messages scrollbar (h-[350px] ScrollArea), 2) Footer visibility conditional on homepage and about us pages only, 3) Curiofact cover image upload and uploader name display. All 9 backend tests passed. Frontend verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Existing curiofacts created by admin directly don't have uploader_name (shows null). Only user-submitted and approved curiofacts will display the uploader name. This is by design.
seed_data_creation: Created test curiofact submissions with image_url for testing (cleaned up after tests)

ConditionalFooter component in App.js checks pathname to show footer only on / and /about. Curiofact submission form has Cover Image URL field (optional). Admin dashboard shows pending curiofacts with images and uploader names.
